body.intent: Fix Request plan runs start outside rhiza.daemon.maxRuns, so the machine runs far more agents than its cap: on 2026-11-08 ~13:05Z, with maxRuns 4 (then 3), the root daemon started the plan runs of requests 01M6XHDV2P65 and 01M6XKT75PHW in the same burst as ship runs of 01M6XHCX4FRE and 01M6WGEPSYWV, leaving 5 running and 1 interrupted (daemon status) and load at 23 on the 4-core VM. Earlier the same day 5 ran at cap 3. Plan runs should count against the machine-wide cap (or a small separate plan cap in rhiza.toml, as policy): a waiting request may reserve the next free slot (#226) but must not exceed the cap. rhiza health should show live runs against the cap.
